heard: Their fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, so fathered Jonathan and Malkishua, Abinadab and Neshbal came, the line of kings in Benjamin's name. Jonathan brought forth Meribah Micah was born to Meribah Pithon melech tereahas, as father Jehoahad eskei. Jehoahad ha-lef-fe-fe, as ma-lef-fen-zin-ri-we-fe.
